en.apps.lead: Find Jev applications, integrations, SDKs, independent alternatives and research. Each listing links to its source evidence and explains its relationship to Jev.
en.f1.body: Choice selects a label, Score returns an expected rubric position, and Noul returns a yes-probability. Score values may be fractional.
en.f2.title: Probability and confidence
en.f2.body: Choice and Score expose distributions and confidence. Noul exposes a yes-probability. These are different signals; evaluate them on your own data.
en.f3.title: Typed outputs can still be wrong
en.f3.body: A constrained answer can be incorrect. Include a review path, test representative cases and monitor errors.
en.f4.title: Your code decides when to act
en.f4.body: Validate answers and set thresholds in application code. Use fallback logic when the evidence is uncertain.
en.pb.lead: Runnable examples using the official Python SDK. Install typesafe-sdk and set TYPESAFE_API_KEY. Running an example makes a billed API request.
en.tl.title: Directory milestones
en.tl.lead: Dated changes to JevHunt. Current catalog freshness is reported separately.
en.cta.lead: Submit a public GitHub repository. Editors check the source evidence and classification before it appears in a scheduled release.

zh-cn.f1.body: Choice 选择标签，Score 返回评分标准上的期望位置，Noul 返回“是”的概率。Score 可以是小数。
zh-cn.f2.title: 概率与置信度
zh-cn.f2.body: Choice 和 Score 提供概率分布与置信度，Noul 提供“是”的概率。它们含义不同，应在自己的数据上验证。

zh-cn.f4.body: 在应用代码中验证结果并设置阈值；证据不足时使用回退逻辑。
zh-cn.pb.lead: 使用官方 Python SDK 的完整示例。安装 typesafe-sdk 并设置 TYPESAFE_API_KEY；运行示例会产生计费 API 请求。
